name: Melody Xmas
storyline:
While browsing the net, Projekt Melody received an unusual message from Santa himself!

He’s way behind on his present quota for the year, and he needs her help in order to save Christmas! Not wanting to miss such a unique opportunity, Melody immediately set off for the North Pole, unassumingly bringing along a stowaway.

While spying on Melody, Malady discovered Santa’s plight. Using her years of professional jewelry heist strategy, she has come up with the ultimate plan to steal all of the presents for herself!

After sneaking her way into the North Pole, only one thing stands in Malady’s way: Projekt Melody, and her damned hammer!
summary: Melody Christmas is a 2D Arcade game featuring Projekt Melody. Help Melody collect all the gifts before Malady steals all the presents for herself!
